description:
We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to high-quality patient care and support the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations. We are looking for a compassionate and skilled professional to help maintain our standards of excellence.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in managing nursing staff, ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. The position offers a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, reflecting your experience and commitment to exceptional care. While an RN license is preferred, we encourage qualified candidates to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa (preferred)
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with some leadership or supervisory experience
Experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of clinical operations and regulatory compliance
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
Join a premier medical center in Winslow, AZ, as an MRI Technician and play a pivotal role in launching our brand-new MRI program. We are excited to install our first-ever MRI unit by November 2026 and are seeking a skilled professional to help us establish and develop this essential new service. This is a unique opportunity to contribute significantly from the ground up, shaping the future of diagnostic imaging at our facility.

We are looking to fill this critical position by late summer or early fall at the latest, ensuring ample time for program development and preparation for the MRI unit's arrival. If you are passionate about MRI technology and eager to make a lasting impact, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: A few years of experience as an MRI Technician.
Demonstrated expertise in MRI safety protocols and procedures.
Ability to assist in the development and implementation of a new MRI program.
